timing.end_to_end_boundary: first upload/submission through all required downloads available
timing.submission_boundary: first asynchronous API submission through last submission return
timing.resident_compute_boundary: launch through final completion; input upload/output download excluded

measured_case_order: case index rotates by round; matching backend cases alternate deterministically; each case is drained

timestamp_boundaries.execution_or_submission_start: worker begins execution or async submission call
timestamp_boundaries.host_completion: host operation closure completes, or non-Metal deferred completion is observed
timestamp_boundaries.metal_commit_observed: async submission call returns after command-buffer commit
timestamp_boundaries.metal_completion_observed: runtime callback observes terminal Metal completion
timestamp_boundaries.retirement_publication: reservations/accounting retire before event/result readiness publication
